questions.question: Which of the following statements correctly defines oligopoly?

options.text: If the market of a particular commodity consists of more than one seller, but the number of sellers is few, the market structure is termed as oligopoly.
If the market of a particular commodity consists of just one seller but the number of customers is very high, the market structure is termed as oligopoly.
If the market of a particular commodity consists of more than one seller but the number of sellers is very high, the market structure is termed as oligopoly.
If the market of a particular commodity consists of just one seller and the number of customers is few, the market structure is termed as oligopoly.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**If the market of a particular commodity consists of more than one seller, but the number of sellers is few, the market structure has termed an oligopoly**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **A market with an oligopoly **has a small number of businesses that are aware of their interdependence **in terms of price and production strategies.**
 
• Each company has a certain amount of market power due to the small number of enterprises.
 
• Oligopoly differs from perfect competition in that each firm must consider its **interconnectedness, from monopolistic competition in that firms have some control over pricing, and from monopoly, in that, a monopolist has no competitors.**
 
• The implications of mutual dependency among firms in pricing and output decisions are** generally the focus of oligopoly study.​**

• A monopoly is a market system where there is only one seller and there are enough barriers to entry for any other sellers.

questions.question: From (3)/(4) of a number P, Ramakrishna subtracts (2)/(3) of another number Q and obtain (5)/(8) as the difference. What is the answer Ramakrishna should obtain if he subtracts eight times of Q from nine times of P?
questions.solution:
Given:

From (3)/(4) of a number P, Ramakrishna subtracts (2)/(3) of another number Q and obtain (5)/(8) as the difference.

Calculation:

(3)/(4) of a number P = (3P)/(4)

(2)/(3) of number Q = (2Q)/(3)

According to the question,

(3P)/(4) - (2Q)/(3) = (5)/(8)

⇒ {(9P - 8Q) over 12} = {5 over 8}

⇒ {(9P - 8Q) over 3} = {5 over 2}

⇒ 9P - 8Q = {5 times 3} over 2

⇒ 9P - 8Q = {15} over 2

**∴ The answer Ramakrishna should obtain is {15} over 2 if he subtracts eight times of Q from nine times of P.**

questions.question: A can do 75% of the work in 30 days while B can do 50% of the same work in 18 days. If they work together, what fraction of the work will be done in 1 day?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Find total days for **A** and **B**: **A** = 30 × (100/75) = 40 days, **B** = 18 × (100/50) = 36 days.

Combined 1-day work fraction = (A + B) ÷ (A × B)

Combined 1-day work = (40 + 36) ÷ (40 × 36) = 76 ÷ 1440 = 19/360.

**∴ The correct answer is 19/360.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**A** does 75% (3/4) work in 30 days.

**B** does 50% (1/2) work in 18 days.

**Calculations:**

⇒ Time taken by **A** to complete 100% work = 30 × (4/3) = **40 days**

⇒ Time taken by **B** to complete 100% work = 18 × 2 = **36 days**

⇒ Let **Total Work** be the LCM of 40 and 36.

 
 

 **Person**
 **Total Days**
 **Total Work (LCM)**
 **Efficiency (Units/Day)**
 
 

 **A**
 40
 360 units
 360 ÷ 40 = **9**
 
 

 **B**
 36
 360 ÷ 36 = **10**
 
 

⇒ Combined **Efficiency** of (A + B) = 9 + 10 = **19 units/day**

⇒ Fraction of work done in 1 day = Combined Efficiency ÷ Total Work

⇒ Fraction = 19 ÷ 360 = **19/360**

**∴ The correct answer is 19/360.**

**__Additional Information__**

Efficiency and Time Relationship

The **Efficiency** of a person is inversely proportional to the **Time** taken to complete the work (Efficiency = 1 ÷ Time).

Combined Work Formula

If **A** can do a piece of work in 'x' days and **B** can do it in 'y' days, then together they can finish it in (x × y) ÷ (x + y) days.

Work Fraction

If a person completes a work in **n** days, the part of work done in 1 day is **1/n**.</p

questions.question: The transformation of silkworms and frog larvae into adults through drastic changes is called __________.

questions.question: What is the formula for Net worth?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Net Worth = Assets - Liabilities**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The book value of the equity held by shareholders of a corporation is referred to as **"Net worth."**
 
• It can also be thought of as the net worth of a corporation that its shareholders would be able to claim in the event that all of its assets were liquidated and all of its obligations were paid off.
 
• To put it another way, it is the sum of assets that remain after all liabilities have been settled.
 
• **Stockholder's equity and shareholder's equity** are other names for a company's net worth.
 
• By deducting the subject company's total liabilities from its total assets, one can arrive at the formula for net worth. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• Although equity and net worth are sometimes used **interchangeably, they are occasionally employed in different circumstances.**
 
• The net worth calculation takes into account both assets and liabilities.
 
• The following are the two things to keep in mind when thinking about net worth:
 
 
• **If net worth is more than zero, it can pay off debt and has strong financial growth. **
 
• **If net worth is zero, the company cannot pay its debts and has negative financial growth.**

⇒ Required SP = (1,729 ÷ 70) × 116

⇒ Required SP = 24.7 × 116 = ₹2,865.20

**∴ The correct answer is ₹2,865.20.**

⇒ CP = 24.7 × 100 = **₹2,470**

**Step 2: Find the new Selling Price (SP₂)**

⇒ SP₂ = CP × (100 + Gain%) ÷ 100

⇒ SP₂ = 2,470 × (100 + 16) ÷ 100

⇒ SP₂ = 2,470 × (116 ÷ 100)

⇒ SP₂ = 2,470 × 1.16

⇒ SP₂ = **₹2,865.20**

Effective Rate for Successive Changes

For two successive changes of a% and b%, the effective change is [a + b + (ab ÷ 100)]%.

⇒ P = 40,000

questions.question: The average of two numbers is 46. Together with a third number, the combined average of three numbers changes to 43. What is the third number?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

**Initial Average** of 2 numbers = 46

**New Average** after adding the 3rd number = 43

**Change in Average** = 43 − 46 = −3

**Third Number** = New Average + (Initial Count × Change)

⇒ 43 + (2 × (−3)) = 43 − 6 = 37

**∴ The correct answer is 37.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Average of 2 numbers = 46, Combined average of 3 numbers = 43.

**Formula Used:** Sum of observations = Average × Number of observations

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/401b71072d4425ea7e0bc4b39027639adbfe55bdbee73f6c60217b1071d316e6.png] 

⇒ Sum of the first 2 numbers = 46 × 2 = 92

⇒ Sum of all 3 numbers = 43 × 3 = 129

⇒ Third number = (Sum of 3 numbers) − (Sum of 2 numbers)

⇒ Third number = 129 − 92

⇒ Third number = 37

**∴ The correct answer is 37.**

**__Additional Information__**

Arithmetic Mean

The average is the sum of all elements divided by the total count: Average = (∑x) ÷ n.

Weighted Average

If two groups have averages A₁ and A₂ with n₁ and n₂ terms, the combined average = (n₁A₁ + n₂A₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂).

Effect of Change

If a constant k is added to every number in a set, the average also increases by k. If multiplied by k, the average is multiplied by k.</p

questions.question: ABCD is a cyclic quadrilateral, AB is a diameter of the circle. If ∠ACD = 35°, find the value of ∠BAD.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

In a circle, angles subtended by the same arc at the circumference are equal. ∴ ∠ABD = ∠ACD = 35°.

Since **AB is the diameter**, the angle in the semicircle ∠ADB = 90°.

In right-angled ΔADB, the sum of acute angles is 90°.

∠BAD = 90° − ∠ABD ⇒ 90° − 35° = 55°.

**∴ The correct answer is 55°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** ABCD is a **cyclic quadrilateral** with **diameter** AB and ∠ACD = 35°.

**Formula Used:** Angle in a semicircle is 90°; Angles in the **same segment** are equal; Sum of angles in a triangle = 180°.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a8a470de9b20cc3c0c45ee47f6ea91ae8cd43e931feddebb338cfdbbd03685b6.png] 

⇒ In the circle, ∠ACD and ∠ABD are subtended by the same **arc AD**.

⇒ ∴ ∠ABD = ∠ACD = 35°

⇒ Since AB is the **diameter**, the angle subtended at the circumference is 90°.

⇒ ∴ ∠ADB = 90°

⇒ In ΔADB, sum of angles = 180°

⇒ ∠BAD + ∠ADB + ∠ABD = 180°

⇒ ∠BAD + 90° + 35° = 180°

⇒ ∠BAD = 180° − 125°

⇒ ∠BAD = 55°

**∴ The correct answer is 55°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Angle in a Semicircle

Any angle subtended by the diameter at any point on the circumference of the circle is always a **right angle (90°)**.

Angles in the Same Segment

Angles subtended by the same arc or chord at any point on the remaining part of the circle are **equal**.

Cyclic Quadrilateral Property

In a cyclic quadrilateral, the sum of each pair of **opposite angles** is 180° (∠A + ∠C = 180° and ∠B + ∠D = 180°).</p

questions.question: A and B can do a piece of work together in 48 days, while B alone can do the work in 60 days. The duo start working together, but B leaves 15 days before the work gets over. For how many days did A and B work together?
questions.solution:
Given:

A and B can do a piece of work together in 48 days.

B alone can do the work in 60 days.

The duo starts working together, but B leaves 15 days before the work gets over.

Concept used:

Total work = Work done per day × Total time taken 

Calculation:

LCM (48, 60) = 240

Let the total work be the individual time taken by the workers.

Now, the total work = 240 units

B does a day = 240/60 = 4 units of work

A and B together do a day = 240/48 = 5 units of work

⇒ A does a day = (5 - 4) units of work

⇒ A does a day = 1 unit of work

Let the total work be completed in K days.

So, A and B will work for K and (K - 15) days.

According to the question,

1 × K + 4 × (K - 15) = 240

⇒ K + 4K - 60 = 240

⇒ 5K = 240 + 60

⇒ 5K = 300

⇒ K = 300/5

⇒ K = 60

Now, the duo worked together for

⇒ (K - 15) days

⇒ (60 - 15) days

⇒ 45 days

**∴ 45 days A and B worked together.**

questions.question: Vimal secured 46% marks in the exam and failed to qualify in the exam by 10 marks. If he secured 52% marks, he would have secured 8 marks more than what was the minimum qualifying marks. What were the minimum marks one had to score to qualify in the exam?

⇒ 0.06Q = 18

⇒ Q = 18/0.06

⇒ Q = 300

Now, the passing marks in the exam

⇒ 0.46 × 300 + 10

⇒ 148

**∴ The minimum marks one had to score to qualify in the exam were 148.**

questions.question: Ramen leaves his home every day at 7:40 am and reaches his office at 9:46 am. One day, he left his home at 7:40 am but travelled one-fourth of the distance at frac{{ 6}}{7} of the usual speed and the rest of the distance at frac{{ 6}}{5} of the usual speed. At what time did Ramen reach office on that day?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Usual time = **9:46 am − 7:40 am** = **126 minutes**.

New time = [Usual Time × (1/4) × (7/6)] + [Usual Time × (3/4) × (5/6)]

New time = [126 × 7/24] + [126 × 15/24] = 126 × (22/24) = **115.5 minutes**.

115.5 minutes = **1 hour 55 minutes 30 seconds**.

Arrival time = 7:40 am + 1 hr 55 min 30 sec = **9:35:30 am**.

**∴ The correct answer is 9:35:30 am.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/84f62667054ad5bd80acfffa1813cfe6a0307e1bee524144b2776593fe10775e.png] 

**Given:** Departure = 7:40 am, Usual Arrival = 9:46 am.

**Formula Used:** Time = Distance ÷ Speed

⇒ Usual Time (T) = 9:46 − 7:40 = 2 hours 6 minutes = **126 minutes**.

⇒ Let usual distance be **D** and usual speed be **S**. T = D/S = 126.

⇒ New Time (Tₙ) = [(1/4)D ÷ (6/7)S] + [(3/4)D ÷ (6/5)S]

⇒ Tₙ = [(1/4) × (7/6) × (D/S)] + [(3/4) × (5/6) × (D/S)]

⇒ Tₙ = (D/S) × [(7/24) + (15/24)] = 126 × (22/24)

⇒ Tₙ = 126 × (11/12) = 10.5 × 11 = **115.5 minutes**.

⇒ 115.5 minutes = **1 hour 55 minutes 30 seconds**.

⇒ New Arrival = 7:40:00 + 1:55:30 = **9:35:30 am**.

**∴ The correct answer is 9:35:30 am.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

questions.question:
Consider the given statement and decide which of the given assumptions is/are implicit in the statement.

**Statement:**

One must wake up early in the morning and exercise.

**Assumptions: **

I. Exercising is not possible at any other time of the day.

II. Everyone who exercises early in the morning is fitter than those who do not.

options.text: Both assumptions I and II are implicit
Neither assumption I nor assumption II is implicit

questions.solution:
Statement: One must wake up early in the morning and exercise.

**Assumption I: Exercising is not possible at any other time of the day.**

This assumption extends beyond what the statement says. The statement merely emphasizes the importance of waking up early to exercise, but it doesn't rule out the possibility of exercising at other times of the day.

**Assumption II: Everyone who exercises early in the morning is fitter than those who do not.**

This assumption introduces an unwarranted comparison of fitness levels based on the timing of exercise, which is not mentioned or implied in the statement. The statement does not comment on the fitness outcomes relative to the timing of exercise.

Given that neither of these assumptions is directly supported or implied by the statement, the correct answer is:

**Neither assumption I nor assumption II is implicit.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 The statement tells us that it is a must to wake up early and exercise in the morning.

However, this statement does not imply that it is not possible to exercise at other times. Therefore, assumption I is not implicit.

The statement does not give any information at all about the effect of early morning exercises. Therefore, assumption II is not implicit.

Hence, neither assumption I nor assumption II is implicit.

questions.question: A two-digit positive number is such that the product of its digits is 24. When 18 is added to the number, the digits interchange their places. Which smallest positive number should be subtracted from the given number to make it a perfect square?
questions.solution:
Given:

A two-digit positive number is such that the product of its digits is 24.

When 18 is added to the number, the digits interchange their places.

Concept used:

(A + B)² = (A - B)² + 4AB

Calculation:

Let the unit and ten's place digits of the number be P and Q respectively.

The number = 10 × Q + P = 10Q + P

When the digits exchange = 10 × P + Q =10P + Q

According to the question,

PQ = 24 ....(1)

10Q + P + 18 = 10P + Q

⇒ 9P - 9Q = 18

⇒ P - Q = 18/9

⇒ P - Q = 2 ...(2)

⇒ (P - Q)² = 2²

⇒ (P - Q)2 + 4PQ = 22 + 4PQ

⇒ (P + Q)2= 22 + 4 × 24 (From 1)

⇒ (P + Q)2 = 100

⇒ (P + Q) = 10 ....(3)

Now solving (2) and (3),

P = 6, Q = 4

So, the number = 10 × 4 + 6 = 46

Closest perfect square integer less than 46 = 36

Now, the smallest positive number that should be subtracted from 46 to make it a perfect square

⇒ 46 - 36

⇒ 10

**∴ 10 should be subtracted from the given number to make it a perfect square.**
